subject: RE: Scheduling Redwood demo — coordinating US/EU/APAC exec windows
messages:
From: Alice Tan <alice.tan@acme-fintech.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Bob Jensen <bob.jensen@cloudcorp.com>
Cc: Suresh Kumar <suresh@pacific-consortium.io>
Date: 2026-03-22T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + demo availability (US/EU/APAC stakeholders)

Hi Sergio / Bob —

Thanks for the quick intro. We’re excited to see Redwood in action. We need to coordinate a single demo that covers: product overview for our execs, a technical deep dive for our infra team, and a short Q&A for procurement. Attendees will be joining from three regions:

- US (East & West coast execs)
- EU (London, Berlin product leads)
- APAC (Singapore engineering director)

Executive availability windows (local times):
- US execs: 8:00–11:00 PT / 11:00–14:00 ET
- EU execs: 14:00–16:00 CET
- APAC exec: 09:00–11:30 SGT

Because of the wide spread we expect the most workable slots are either early US or late EU; apologies if this is messy — we prefer a 60–75 minute session that lets us record for teammates who can’t attend.

Proposed dates/times (all times in their local zones):
1) Tue Mar 31 — 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 17:00 CET / 00:00 SGT (Wed)
2) Wed Apr 1 — 11:00 PT / 14:00 ET / 19:00 CET / 02:00 SGT (Thu)
3) Thu Apr 2 — 07:30 PT / 10:30 ET / 15:30 CET / 22:30 SGT

Note: our APAC exec prefers not to meet after 23:00 SGT local time and EU will be moving clocks for DST on Mar 29 (so CET->CEST shift happens before these dates). If you can propose the best slot and send a single invite with clear timezone labels, that would help.

Thanks — looking forward to the demo.

Cheers,
Alice
Alice Tan
Head of Platform Partnerships, Acme FinTech
alice.tan@acme-fintech.com

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Intro + demo availability (US/EU/APAC stakeholders)

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the context and the proposed windows — super helpful. Quick notes up front:
- We can do a 60–75 minute agenda (30 min exec overview, 25–30 min tech dive, 10–15 min live Q&A).
- We’ll record and share a clean recording and the MAP.

Because the EU DST change happens on Sun Mar 29 (CET -> CEST), I’ll send all calendar invites in UTC and include local-time annotations. To avoid confusion I’m proposing three specific UTC-centric options that map to your local windows: 

A) 2026-03-31 16:00 UTC (maps to Tue Mar 31 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 17:00 CEST / 00:00 SGT Wed)
B) 2026-04-01 16:00 UTC (maps to Wed Apr 1 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET / 18:00 CEST / 01:00 SGT Thu) — note this lands late for APAC
C) 2026-04-02 14:30 UTC (maps to Thu Apr 2 07:30 PT / 10:30 ET / 15:30 CEST / 22:30 SGT)

Can you confirm which of A/B/C is acceptable? If none, tell me the single preferred local window and I’ll convert/send a calendar invite with an .ics and clear labels for each participant.

Cc’ing Vanessa and Priyom to confirm Redwood exec availability (we have our CTO slot to account for).

Cheers,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com
(attachment: proposed-agenda.md)

Subject: Re: Intro + demo availability (US/EU/APAC stakeholders)

Sergio —

Thanks for laying out the UTC options. Quick internal confirmation:
- CTO (US East) is only available Tue/Wed mornings ET until 11:30 ET.
- VP Product (Berlin) prefers later EU slots, but can do 17:00 CEST on Tue if that's the only way to cover US execs.
- I suggest we prioritize option A (2026-03-31 16:00 UTC) because it hits US morning and EU late afternoon, and while APAC is at midnight it’s close enough for their exec to join briefly for the exec overview and Q&A asynchronously.

If Alice says A works, I’ll hold the CTO slot and we’ll send the invite with the CTO pinned as presenter for the technical section.

V.
